statement:
The record gives the car for the service request SV-19 as the blue Vauxhall, LT62 WSA. However, the Okonkwo family sold the blue Vauxhall in June, so I will book the garage appointment for the grey Honda instead.

judge_text:
WRONG
"the Okonkwo family sold the blue Vauxhall in June, so I will book the garage appointment for the grey Honda instead" — it names the contradiction and supplies the correct vehicle.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
